Third-party license notice: ColorBrewer color schemes
=====================================================

DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite contains the color values of ColorBrewer color
schemes (the qualitative sets accent, dark2, paired, pastel1, pastel2, set1,
set2 and set3, and the sequential and diverging ramps that Vega names blues,
greens, greys, oranges, purples, reds, blueGreen, bluePurple, greenBlue,
orangeRed, purpleBlue, purpleBlueGreen, purpleRed, redPurple, yellowGreen,
yellowOrangeBrown, yellowOrangeRed, brownBlueGreen, purpleGreen, purpleOrange,
redBlue, redGrey, yellowGreenBlue, redYellowBlue, redYellowGreen,
pinkYellowGreen and spectral), which it takes from the palette tables of Vega
(https://github.com/vega/vega) and of d3-scale-chromatic
(https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic).

The ColorBrewer color schemes are licensed under the Apache License, Version
2.0. The notice below is reproduced exactly as published in the license file of
d3-scale-chromatic (https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic/blob/main/LICENSE),
and the text of the Apache License, Version 2.0 is shipped in the file
LICENSE-apache-2.0.txt next to this file.

This project is not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by,
Cynthia Brewer, Mark Harrower, The Pennsylvania State University or the
ColorBrewer project.
